releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram plan MD is Telegram-compatible (no raw HTML, RTL Persian, tables→lists, formatted chat preview)
Feature: Header local terminal modal at project root with Cmder-like colors (existing Deploy terminal unchanged)
Feature: Send images as Telegram documents (full quality) and pass them to Cursor ACP/CLI
Fix: Plan turn no longer sends a duplicate reply card before preview+file
Fix: Build-plan status message no longer shows raw HTML tags
Fix: Local terminal no longer injects noisy ANSI prompt setup text
